name: Summit AZ - Context - Not Indexed Pull 2026-06-16
body:
> Log · Summit Az · 2026-06-16

# Summary
GSC not-indexed pull for the URL-prefix property https://www.summitplumbingpros.com/ (data as of 6/12/26). Site healthy: 98 indexed, 16 not indexed across 4 reasons.

# Breakdown
- Page with redirect: 8 (intentional). Not found 404: 3 (gone). Excluded by noindex: 1 (intentional). Crawled, currently not indexed: 4.
- Of the 4: a wp-emoji JS file and `/feed/` (junk, skipped), plus `/expert-drain-line-services/` and `/phoenix-plumbing/`.
- Action: indexing requested for the two real pages (2 of about 13 daily quota).
- `/phoenix-plumbing/` had no referring sitemap.

# Later correction
The 2026-06-23 audit found both pages carry canonicals to other URLs (`/drain-cleaning/` and `/general-plumbing-services-in-phoenix/`), so they will never index and the quota was wasted. See [Summit AZ - SEO AEO Audit 2026-06-23](lib:brain-summit-az-seo-aeo-audit-2026-06-23).
